mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, temperatures are sitting at 59 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon tonight, and while the ISS will pass overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced that road maintenance for crack filling will begin on September 28. Work will be weather dependent and may cause lane closures in several areas, including South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street. Additionally, the Plan Commission is scheduled to review several development projects on October 5.

There is plenty to do in Verona this week! You can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Then, look forward to the Verona Fall Fest happening this Thursday, September 25.

In a recent report regarding noteworthy calls, officers handled an incident on September 5 where a driver was arrested for O W I after being stopped for traveling 83 miles per hour in a 65 zone on the highway.
The Culver's in Verona is currently open until 10:00 PM, though please note they are closed for a remodel and are not serving the flavor of the day at this time.
